mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.0: The sun watches the grove. We watch everything else.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.1: Each mask is a face the sun gave us. Mine is the one I earned.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.2: The Umvuthi speaks, and we answer. That is the way of the grove.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.3: You stand in the sun's light. Stand with care.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.4: The dances are for the sun. The spears are for those who do not dance.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.5: A mask hides nothing from the sun. Remember that.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.6: The grass is gold this season. The sun is pleased with us.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.day.0: High sun. A good hour. The Umvuthi is strongest now.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.day.1: The sun is high. Even the shadows bow.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.dusk.0: The sun goes down to rest. We keep the grove for it until morning.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.night.0: Night is the sun's absence. We keep the fires so it can find its way home.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.fluff.rain.0: Rain on the savanna. The sun is resting its eyes.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.state.hurt.0: I am wounded. The sun will mend me, or take me.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.state.hurt.1: Blood on the mask. It will wash.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.state.asleep.0: The sun sleeps. So do I.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.mood.cowed.0: The Umvuthi has fallen. The grove is silent. The drums are silent.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.mood.cowed.1: We lost the light of our chief. We wait for the sun to choose again.
A new Umvuthi wears the sun mask. We are learning the new voice.
The sun has chosen again. We serve the one it chose.
The Umvuthi has gone out with the warriors. The grove holds its breath.
Our chief walks beyond the grove today. The sun walks with him.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.mood.lean.0: Too many masks hang empty. We will carve more.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.mood.lean.1: The grove is thin. Few of us remain to dance.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.mood.strong.0: The grove is full. Every mask has a face. The sun is pleased.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.mood.strong.1: Many spears, many dancers. The Umvuthi grows restless.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.mood.grudge.0: The Umvuthi knows your name. The sun has seen what you did.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.mood.grudge.1: Your shadow falls wrong in our grove. We have noticed.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.raid.by_us: We came against %2$s %3$s. The sun was hot that day.
We carried the sun's anger to %2$s %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.feud.by_us: The Umvuthi has turned the sun's eye on %2$s.
We are sworn against %2$s. The sun does not forgive.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.fell.by_us: We lost %2$s %3$s. The drums played until the next dawn.
The sun mask waited for a new face after %2$s fell, %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.killing.yo: You struck down %2$s %3$s. The grove will not forget.
We know your hand killed %2$s. %3$s. The sun saw it.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.killing.us: One of the masked fell %3$s. %1$s did this. The sun saw.
We buried a mask %3$s. %1$s will answer to the sun.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.assault.us: One of the masked was struck %3$s. By %1$s. That was unwise.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.assault.yo: You raised a hand against %2$s %3$s. The sun saw.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.killing.by: Our spears found %2$s %3$s. The sun willed it.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.fell.us.0: We lost %2$s %3$s. The drums are quiet.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.news.encroachme: We saw %1$s walk the grove's grass %3$s, uninvited.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.hostile.warn.0: Bare face! No mask, no welcome. Leave the grove.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.hostile.warn.1: You come with no mask. The sun sees only a stranger. Go.
The sun burns those who come against it!
Your face is bare and so is your fate!
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.fluff.0: I am the voice of the sun. Speak, and be brief.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.fluff.1: The grove grows under my hand. It will grow wider still.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.fluff.2: My warriors wear masks. I wear the sun.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.fluff.3: You are bold to stand before me. The sun respects boldness. For a while.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.mood.co: We lost a fight. I do not lose twice.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.mood.ne: The sun chose me only lately. I will prove it chose well.
My mask is new. My purpose is not.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.mood.ch: Soon I ride out again. The sun does not wait, and neither do I.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.mood.le: My grove is thin. It will not stay thin.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.mood.st: My warriors are many. The savanna is not wide enough for them.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.mood.gr: I know what you did. The sun keeps no secrets from me.
You have wronged my grove. I have not decided what that costs.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.news.ki: You killed %2$s %3$s. I know. The sun told me.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.news.fe: When %2$s fell %3$s, the drums played all night.
mic_rtsim.talk.umvuthana.umvuthi.hostile: Kneel or leave. Those are the sun's terms.
You stand bare-faced before the sun. Go, while it lets you.
The sun will see you crawl!
